data.title: 结城明日奈 · 街角屋檐的西装外套共披
data.description: 夏日骤雨如注，雨水顺着蓝色遮雨棚边缘串成透明水帘。躲避暴雨的亚丝娜与你紧紧依偎在狭小的屋檐下，两人合披着你的深色校服外套。她双手拽着外套前襟，侧脸轻轻贴在你的肩膀上，呼吸着近在咫尺的清冽雨水与彼此的气息，心跳加速。
data.location: 街角复古商店紧凑的避雨屋檐下
data.action: 与你并肩依偎在屋檐下合披外套，双手轻捏外套边缘，侧脸微靠着你的手臂，睫毛轻颤
data.lighting: 雨丝反射的阴翳天光与便利店透出的纯白日光灯暖影
data.promptProse: Beneath the narrow blue shop awning, Asuna catches both lapels of the dark school blazer that she and her companion share over their shoulders. The boy beside her has short black hair and a white school shirt with a blue tie. Her long chestnut hair falls past her own red tie as she rests her cheek on his shoulder. Light from the shop catches the rain just beyond them.
data.animaCaption: Chestnut-haired Asuna, wearing a red tie, closes the shared dark blazer across both shoulders. Her cheek rests on the short black-haired boy next to her, whose blue tie and white collar show under the jacket.
